translations.Manuelle Low-Level-Diagnose für die BAOS: Manual low-level diagnostics for the BAOS UART connection. Connection test, Reset.Req and firmware query only talk locally to the BAOS module and do not switch any KNX group objects.
translations.Host-Seite des BAOS 838 kBerry: 3,3 V UA: Host side of the BAOS 838 kBerry: 3.3 V UART, TX/RX crossed. This diagnostic locally sends an FT1.2 Reset.Req and a GetServerItem firmware query to the BAOS module. Incoming BAOS datapoint indications can now trigger LED actions.
translations.BAOS 838 kBerry wird hostseitig mit 1152: BAOS 838 kBerry is used host-side with 115200 baud and 8E1. If raw TX bytes rise but RX stays 0, first test auto-baud, then check wiring/3.3 V host supply. Run the loopback test only without a connected BAOS module. Expectation: RX +5 bytes, ACK +1, Fixed +1, Checksum OK +1. Do not run loopback on a real BAOS module.
translations.DatapointValue.Ind kommt asynchron vom B: DatapointValue.Ind arrives asynchronously from the BAOS when a KNX group object was updated. GetDatapointDescription shows whether ETS created the datapoints at all. Error 0x07 typically means: datapoint not configured in ETS or out of range.
translations.Dieser Stand wertet eingehende BAOS-Date: This build evaluates incoming BAOS datapoints. Status TX uses SetDatapointValue as soon as BAOS is connected. Make sure the ETS DPT lengths match the KLC objects.
translations.RX-Parser wertet DatapointValue.Ind aus;: RX parser evaluates DatapointValue.Ind; TX test remains diagnostics or a targeted BAOS query.
translations.Damit kann späteres KNX-Verhalten schon: This allows future KNX behavior to be tested without BAOS hardware. Example: object
translations.Diese Datenpunkt-/Objektnummern sollten: These datapoint/object numbers should preferably not be changed after the initial ETS setup. 0 means disabled. Lock/force object behavior per output is changed on the normal KNX page.
translations.ACK empfangen, aber keine BAOS ObjectSer: ACK received but no BAOS ObjectServer reply
translations.Bad ID: DP ausserhalb Bereich oder nicht: Bad ID: DP out of range or not configured in ETS
translations.BAOS Reset.Req gesendet, warte auf ACK: BAOS Reset.Req sent, waiting for ACK
translations.BAOS Reset.Req konnte nicht gesendet wer: BAOS Reset.Req could not be sent
translations.BAOS-TX-Test konnte nicht vollstaendig g: BAOS TX test could not be sent completely
translations.Firmware-Abfrage konnte nicht gesendet w: Firmware query could not be sent
translations.kein ACK und kein RX auf BAOS Reset.Req: no ACK and no RX on BAOS Reset.Req
translations.kein ACK vom BAOS-Modul: no ACK from the BAOS module
translations.kein BAOS ObjectServer-Frame auf Firmwar: no BAOS ObjectServer frame on firmware query
translations.kein Element: DP nicht konfiguriert/kein: no element: DP not configured/no value
translations.RX vorhanden, aber kein ACK auf BAOS Res: RX present but no ACK on BAOS Reset.Req
translations.Ethernet, WLAN Client und Access Point k: Ethernet, WiFi client and access point can run at the same time. The WebUI stays reachable via all active interfaces; the priority only affects outgoing connections such as update check and download. The radio module only supports 2.4 GHz WiFi networks.
translations.Passwörter werden nicht angezeigt und ni: Passwords are neither displayed nor exported. Leaving the field empty keeps the stored password. Changes take effect immediately; existing WiFi connections are re-established in the process.
translations.Abgelehnt: Ethernet, WLAN Client und AP: Rejected: Ethernet, WiFi client and AP must not all be disabled
translations.Keine typischen Konfigurationsfehler erk: No typical configuration errors detected. Still check hardware such as level shifter, ground and data direction separately.
translations.die Oberfläche weicht auf Englisch aus (: the interface falls back to English (built-in fallback language) and retries the download automatically. Status:
translations.Automatisch: Der Browser wählt die Sprac: Automatic: the browser picks the language. If its language pack is missing, the interface shows English and fetches the pack in the background (once, internet required).
translations.Dauer des Einschaltens in Sekunden. 0 sc: Switch-on duration in seconds. 0 switches immediately; a larger value means a slower transition.
translations.Dauer des Ausschaltens in Sekunden. 0 sc: Switch-off duration in seconds. 0 switches immediately; a larger value means a slower transition.
translations.Freier Name der Power-Gruppe, z.B. Netzt: Custom name for the power group, e.g. living-room power supply.
translations.Strombudget dieser Gruppe in Milliampere: Power budget of this group in milliamperes, usually the rated power of the associated power supply.
translations.Legt fest, was bei einem KNX-Schaltteleg: Determines what is switched on with a KNX switching telegram with value 1.
translations.Letzter Wert/Sequenz stellt den vorherig: Last value/sequence restores the previous state. Fixed values use RGBW percentages. Fixed scene starts the selected scene.
translations.Diese Szene wird beim KNX-Einschalten mi: This scene is started with value 1 when the KNX is switched on.
translations.Fester Rotanteil beim Einschalten, 0 bis: Fixed red content when switching on, 0 to 100 percent.
translations.Fester Grünanteil beim Einschalten, 0 bi: Fixed green content when switched on, 0 to 100 percent.
translations.Fester Blauanteil beim Einschalten, 0 bi: Fixed blue content when switched on, 0 to 100 percent.
translations.Fester Weißanteil beim Einschalten, 0 bi: Fixed white content when switched on, 0 to 100 percent.
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Zentral Ein/Au: BAOS data point number for central on/off
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für zentrale Szene: BAOS data point number for central scenes
translations.1-Bit-Objekt: schaltet ALLE Kanäle durch: 1-bit object: switches ALL channels through the scene pool. Telegram 1 = forward, 0 = back. 0 = Object not occupied.
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für zentrales Weit: BAOS data point number for central next/back (0 = off)
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für zentrale Helli: BAOS data point number for central brightness
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Grün: BAOS data point number for green
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Blau: BAOS data point number for blue
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Weiß: BAOS data point number for white
translations.KNX-Objekt zum dauerhaften Ein-/Ausschal: KNX object for permanently switching Ethernet on/off. Way back: Hold the service button for 2-5 s (network reset).
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für den Ethernet-S: BAOS data point number for the Ethernet switch
translations.KNX-Objekt zum dauerhaften Ein-/Ausschal: KNX object for permanently switching WLAN (client and AP) on/off. Way back: Hold the service button for 2-5 s (network reset).
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für den WLAN-Schal: BAOS data point number for the WLAN switch
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Power-Limit-St: BAOS data point number for power limit status
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Fehlerstatus: BAOS data point number for error status
translations.Statusobjekt: meldet den Schaltzustand d: Status object: reports the switching status of the Ethernet switch.
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für den Ethernet-S: BAOS data point number for the Ethernet switching status
translations.Statusobjekt: meldet den Schaltzustand d: Status object: reports the switching status of the WLAN switch.
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für den WLAN-Schal: BAOS data point number for WLAN switching status
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Ein/Aus: BAOS data point number for on/off
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Szene: BAOS data point number for scene
translations.1-Bit-Objekt: schaltet diesen Kanal durc: 1-bit object: switches this channel through the scene pool. Telegram 1 = forward, 0 = back. 0 = Object not occupied.
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Weiter/Zurück: BAOS data point number for next/back (0 = off)
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Helligkeit: BAOS data point number for brightness
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Sperre: BAOS data point number for lock
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Zwangsobjekt: BAOS data point number for forced object
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Szenenstatus: BAOS data point number for scene status
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Helligkeitssta: BAOS data point number for brightness status
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Sperrstatus: BAOS data point number for lock status
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Zwangsstatus: BAOS data point number for forced status
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Schaltstatus: BAOS data point number for switching status
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Rot-Status: BAOS data point number for red status
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Grün-Status: BAOS data point number for green status
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Blau-Status: BAOS data point number for blue status
translations.BAOS-Datenpunktnummer für Weiß-Status: BAOS data point number for white status
translations.Ablauf, der mit Szene zentral starten au: Sequence started simultaneously on all active outputs by the central scene command.
translations.Aktualisiert die Tabelle unten automatis: Automatically updates the table below every few seconds. Switching it off saves network traffic, e.g. over slow connections.
translations.LED-Versatz: korrigiert Startpunkt, Stos: LED offset: corrects starting point, joint point or felt center.
translations.Selbständig = eigener Kanal. Sonst folgt: Independent = own channel. Otherwise this channel follows the selected master channel and both form ONE long LED strip. The LED chip, LED colors and color order are inherited from the master. Channels that already have a follower, use string segments or would create a loop cannot be selected.
translations.Nur bei Verkettung: dreht die Pixelreihe: Only when chained: reverses the pixel order of this chain link if the strand is physically soldered upside down.
translations.Legt fest, was dieser Ausgang nach einem: Determines what this output does automatically after a reboot or power failure.
translations.Aus bleibt dunkel. Letzte Einstellung st: Off remains dark. Last setting restores the last known state. Fixed scene always starts the selected scene.
translations.Diese Szene wird nur verwendet, wenn Nac: This scene is only used if After power interruption is set to Fixed scene.
translations.Wählt das Timingprofil des verbauten LED: Selects the timing profile of the installed LED chip.
translations.Legt fest, ob der Strip drei Kanäle RGB: Determines whether the strip expects three channels of RGB or four channels of RGBW per LED.
translations.Korrigiert die Reihenfolge der Farbbytes: Corrects the order of color bytes when red, green or blue are displayed swapped.
translations.Ändere diesen Wert, wenn die Testfarben: Change this value if the test colors on the strip do not match the selected color.
translations.Anzeigename dieses LED-Ausgangs in Webob: Display name of this LED output in web interface, diagnostics and status lists.
translations.Freier Name, damit der Ausgang später le: Free name so that the output is easier to recognize later.
translations.Schaltet diesen Ausgang logisch ein oder: Logically enables or disables this output. Disabled outputs are not physically driven.
translations.Aktivieren, wenn dieser LED-Ausgang verw: Enable if this LED output is to be used.
translations.Anzahl der LEDs/Pixel an diesem physisch: Number of LEDs/pixels on this physical data string.
translations.Gesamtzahl der LEDs am Ausgang. Wichtig: Total number of LEDs at the output. Important for effects, current estimation and PIO/DMA output time.
translations.Teilt einen langen physischen String in: Splits a long physical string into logical repetitions of equal size.
translations.1 bedeutet normaler String. Bei unpassen: 1 means normal string. If values are unsuitable, the next matching segment value is displayed.
translations.Korrigiert den logischen Startpunkt oder: Corrects the logical starting point or perceived center of an LED string.
translations.Ordnet den Ausgang einer Netzteil-/Leist: Assigns the output to a power-supply/power group.
Only one power group is available.
translations.Ausgänge in derselben Power-Gruppe teile: Outputs in the same power group share a power budget.
translations.Maximal erlaubter Strom für diesen Ausga: Maximum permitted current for this output.
translations.Stromgrenze in Milliampere. Wird für War: Current limit in milliamperes. Used for warnings and power limiting.
translations.Begrenzt die Helligkeit dieses Ausgangs: Limits the brightness of this output regardless of scene colors.
translations.0 bleibt dunkel, 255 ist volle Helligkei: 0 remains dark, 255 is full brightness. Values in between reduce all colors of this output.
translations.Pixelreihenfolge dieses Kettenglieds ist: Pixel order of this chain link is reversed
translations.Ausgänge mit aktuell laufendem manuellem: Outputs currently running a manual color or edge test
translations.Globale Helligkeit über alle Ausgänge, 0: Global brightness across all outputs, 0 to 255. Works in addition to the scene brightness and the maximum brightness per output.
translations.Gesamtstrom-Obergrenze des Controllers i: Total current upper limit of the controller in milliamperes. If the sum of all outputs threatens to exceed it, it will be dimmed automatically.
translations.Fester, nicht dimmbarer Grundverbrauch i: Fixed, non-dimmable basic consumption in milliamperes, e.g. controller and LED quiescent currents. Is counted towards the limit.
translations.Sicherheitsreserve in Prozent: Nur diese: Safety reserve in percent: Only this portion of the limits is actually used. 80 means that with a 10 A limit, dimming starts at 8 A.
translations.Strom einer LED bei vollem Rot in Millia: Current of an LED at full red in milliamperes. Basis of load estimation; can be determined by current profile measurement below.
translations.Strom einer LED bei vollem Grün in Milli: Current of an LED at full green in milliamperes.
translations.Strom einer LED bei vollem Blau in Milli: Current of an LED at full blue in milliamperes.
translations.Strom einer LED bei vollem Weißkanal in: Current of an LED at full white channel in milliamperes. Only relevant for RGBW strips.
translations.Ruhestrom je LED in Milliampere, wenn si: Quiescent current per LED in milliamperes when it is dark but powered.
Number of power-supply groups in use. Each group has its own power budget; outputs are assigned to groups.
translations.Anzeige: aktuell geschätzte Last aller A: Display: current estimated load of all outputs in this group.
translations.Anzeige: Ruhestrom aller dunklen LEDs di: Display: Quiescent current of all dark LEDs in this group.
translations.Anzeige: tatsächlich genutzte Grenze nac: Display: actually used limit after deducting the safety reserve.
translations.Ausgang, an dem die Messreihe läuft. Am: Output on which the measurement series runs. Preferably one with an easily accessible power supply.
translations.Wie viele LEDs für die Messung eingescha: How many LEDs are switched on for the measurement. More LEDs = more accurate result per LED.
translations.Gemessener Strom am Netzteil, wenn alle: Measured current on the power supply when all LEDs are off. This results in base current plus standby.
translations.Gemessener Strom, wenn die Mess-LEDs vol: Measured current when the measurement LEDs light up full red.
Measured current when the measurement LEDs light up fully green.
Measured current when the measurement LEDs light up full blue.
translations.Optionale Kontrollmessung: Rot, Grün und: Optional control measurement: Red, green and blue at the same time. Checks whether the individual values are plausible.
translations.Gemessener Strom des separaten Weißkanal: Measured current of the separate white channel. Only necessary for RGBW strips.
translations.Hauptschalter für das Funkmodul: schalte: Main switch for the radio module: switches the WLAN client and access point on or off together. Way back without WebUI: Hold the service button for 2-5 s.
translations.Verbindet den Controller als Client mit: Connects the controller as a client to the home network WLAN. Independent of the access point.
translations.Name des WLAN-Netzes, mit dem sich der C: Name of the WLAN network to which the client should connect. Only 2.4 GHz networks are supported.
translations.Passwort des WLAN-Netzes. Feld leer lass: Password of the WLAN network. Leave field blank keeps the saved password; it is never displayed or exported.
translations.IP-Adresse für den WLAN-Client automatis: Obtain IP address for the WLAN client automatically from the router. Without a tick, the static WLAN values below apply.
translations.Feste IP-Adresse des WLAN-Clients, wenn: Fixed IP address of the WLAN client when WLAN DHCP is off.
translations.Gateway (meist der Router) für den WLAN-: Gateway (usually the router) for the WLAN client with a static address.
translations.Subnetzmaske des WLAN-Clients bei statis: Subnet mask of the WLAN client with a static address, usually 255.255.255.0.
translations.DNS-Server für den WLAN-Client bei stati: DNS server for the WLAN client with a static address, usually the router IP.
translations.Eigenes Service-WLAN des Controllers für: The controller's own service WLAN for setup and emergency access, independent of the home network.
translations.Name des Service-WLANs. Leer lassen erze: Name of the service WLAN. Leave blank automatically generates KLC plus serial number.
translations.Passwort des Service-WLANs. Feld leer la: Service WiFi password. Leave the field blank to keep the saved password.
translations.IP-Adresse des Controllers im Service-WL: IP address of the controller in the service WLAN. Clients automatically receive a suitable address.
translations.Bevorzugtes Interface für ausgehende Ver: Preferred interface for outgoing connections such as update checking and NTP. In the event of a subnet collision, it also determines which interface holds the LAN and which goes into standby.
translations.Schaltet den Kabelanschluss (W5500) ein: Switches the cable connection (W5500) on or off. Without a hook, a missing Ethernet module is no longer an error. Way back without WebUI: Hold the service button for 2-5 s.
translations.Anzeigename des Geräts in WebUI und Stat: Display name of the device in WebUI and status lists. Purely cosmetic, no network function.
translations.Netzwerkname des Controllers, z.B. für d: Network name of the controller, e.g. for the address line in the browser. Changes take effect after a restart.
translations.IP-Adresse für Ethernet automatisch vom: Obtain IP address for Ethernet automatically from the router. Without a tick, the static values below apply.
translations.Feste IP-Adresse für Ethernet, wenn DHCP: Fixed IP address for Ethernet when DHCP is off.
translations.Gateway (meist der Router) für Ethernet: Gateway (usually the router) for Ethernet with a static address.
translations.Subnetzmaske für Ethernet bei statischer: Subnet mask for Ethernet with static address, usually 255.255.255.0.
translations.DNS-Server für Ethernet bei statischer A: DNS server for Ethernet with static address, usually the router IP.
translations.Notfalladresse: Scheitert DHCP, nimmt de: Emergency address: If DHCP fails, the controller takes this fixed address after a short wait so that it remains accessible.
Fixed emergency IP if DHCP fails.
translations.Wählt den Ablauf, den die Canvas-Vorscha: Selects the sequence played in the canvas preview. The real LED output remains unaffected.
translations.Zeitraffer nur für die Vorschau: 4x spie: Time-lapse applies only to the preview: 4x plays the sequence four times faster. The firmware always runs in real time.
translations.Springt an eine beliebige Stelle der Zei: Jumps to any point in the timeline. Can also be scrubbed directly with the mouse or finger over the preview image.
translations.Wählt den Ablauf, der unten im Editor be: Selects the sequence edited below. The Pool suffix identifies sequences in the KNX scene pool.
translations.Benennt den oben ausgewählten Ablauf um,: Renames the sequence selected above without opening the editor.
translations.Kopiert alle Einstellungen des ausgewähl: Copies all settings of the selected sequence to the target slot. The target sequence is overwritten.
translations.Schaltet diesen Ablauf ein oder aus. Dea: Enables or disables this sequence. When disabled, all values remain stored, but the sequence is not offered through KNX or Control.
translations.Freier Anzeigename des Ablaufs. Erschein: Custom display name of the sequence. It appears in Control, selection fields and the sequence overview.
translations.In den KNX-Szenen-Pool aufnehmen. Nur Po: Add to the KNX scene pool. The KNX object next/previous scene only switches through pool scenes (telegram 1 = forward, 0 = back), ascending with circulation.
translations.Animation beim Einschalten des Ablaufs,: Animation used when the sequence is switched on, before the main phase begins. No start effect means starting the main phase immediately.
translations.Dauer der Start-Animation in Millisekund: Duration of the start animation in milliseconds. 0 = immediately; with ramp the fade-in time. For running effects, empty or 0 uses the automatic duration of the number of pixels times the step time.
translations.Laufende Effekte ziehen in der Startphas: Running effects leave a softly sloping tail behind them in the starting phase. The tail length is under afterglow percent.
translations.Effekt während der Hauptphase, also sola: Effect used during the main phase while the sequence is on. Off means everything remains dark after the start effect.
translations.Dauer der Hauptphase in Millisekunden. 0: Duration of the main phase in milliseconds. 0 keeps it on until the sequence is stopped through KNX or Control. A value greater than 0 then starts the off effect automatically.
translations.Größe der fallenden Tetris-Bausteine in: Size of the falling Tetris blocks in the starting phase: random range from minimum to maximum, in pixels. Same values = fixed block size.
Size of the falling Tetris blocks in the main phase: random range from minimum to maximum, in pixels.
Size of the falling Tetris blocks in the switch-off phase: random range from minimum to maximum, in pixels.
translations.Fallrichtung der Bausteine in der Startp: Reverse the direction of fall of the blocks in the start phase: instead of from pixel 1 towards the end, everything falls from the end towards pixel 1.
translations.Fallrichtung der Bausteine in der Hauptp: Reverse the direction of fall of the blocks in the main phase.
translations.Fallrichtung der Bausteine in der Aussch: Reverse the direction of fall of the blocks in the switch-off phase.
translations.Jeder Baustein der Startphase bekommt ei: Each block in the start phase gets a random color instead of the scene color.
translations.Jeder Baustein der Hauptphase bekommt ei: Each building block in the main phase gets a random color instead of the scene color.
translations.Jeder Baustein der Ausschaltphase bekomm: Each block in the switch-off phase gets a random color instead of the scene color.
translations.Wie der fertige Tetris-Aufbau der Startp: How the finished Tetris structure of the starting phase disappears again before the main phase takes over.
translations.Wie ein fertiger Tetris-Aufbau in der Ha: How a finished Tetris structure is dismantled in the main phase before the next construction cycle begins.
translations.Wie der Tetris-Abbau in der Ausschaltpha: How Tetris dismantling occurs in the switch-off phase until all pixels are dark.
translations.Statt fester Schrittzeit werden Pause un: Instead of a fixed step time, the pause and fall time of each block are randomly rolled from the areas below. Seems more organic, but less predictable.
translations.Zufallsbereich der Wartezeit zwischen zw: Random range of the waiting time between two blocks in milliseconds. Only applies when random timing is active.
translations.Zufallsbereich der Fallzeit eines einzel: Random range of the fall time of an individual block in milliseconds. Only applies when random timing is active.
translations.Zeigt den nächsten fallenden Block schon: Shows the next falling block already dimmed at the starting point, like the preview in the Tetris game.
translations.Wechselt die Fallrichtung nach jedem fer: Changes the direction of fall after each completed assembly: once from the front, once from the back.
translations.Alle Kanäle und String-Segmente bauen im: All channels and string segments build in unison instead of independently of each other.
translations.Jeder Block bekommt eine zufällige Farbe: Each block gets a random color with the set HSV minimum distance from the previous one.
translations.Dreht die Grundrichtung des Fallens um:: Reverses the basic direction of falling: blocks stack at the beginning of the strand instead of at the end.
Random range of block size in pixels. Same values = fixed size.
translations.Wie ein fertiger Tetris_2-Aufbau wieder: How a finished Tetris_2 structure disappears again.
translations.Zufallsbereich der Wartezeit zwischen zw: Random range of the waiting time between two blocks in milliseconds.
translations.LED-Dichte des Strangs. Rechnet die Gesc: LED density of the strand. Converts the speed in mm/s to pixels per second; For 60 strips, enter 60.
translations.Zufallsbereich der Fallgeschwindigkeit i: Random range of falling speed in millimeters per second, independent of LED density.
translations.Wahrscheinlichkeit in Prozent, dass der: Probability in percent that the next block starts while the current one is still falling.
translations.Wie früh der nächste Block startet: Zufa: How early the next block starts: random area in percent of the remaining distance of the current block.
translations.Mindestabstand aufeinanderfolgender Zufa: Minimum distance between consecutive random colors on the HSV color wheel (0-180 degrees). Higher = more clearly distinguishable colors.
translations.Abstand zwischen dem Aufleuchten neuer F: Distance between new sparks lighting up in the starting phase, in milliseconds. Smaller = denser flicker.
Distance between lighting up of new sparks in the main phase, in milliseconds.
Distance between new sparks lighting up in the switch-off phase, in milliseconds.
translations.Wie viel Prozent der LEDs in der Startph: How many percent of the LEDs should sparkle at the same time in the start phase.
translations.Wie viel Prozent der LEDs in der Hauptph: How many percent of the LEDs in the main phase should sparkle at the same time.
translations.Wie viel Prozent der LEDs in der Ausscha: How many percent of the LEDs should sparkle at the same time in the switch-off phase.
translations.Wie lange ein einzelner Funke der Startp: How long a single spark in the starting phase lights up and goes out, in milliseconds.
translations.Wie lange ein einzelner Funke der Hauptp: How long a single spark in the main phase lights up and goes out, in milliseconds.
translations.Wie lange ein einzelner Funke der Aussch: How long a single spark in the switch-off phase lights up and glows out, in milliseconds.
translations.Dauer eines kompletten Puls- oder Blinkz: Duration of a complete pulse or flashing cycle of the start phase in milliseconds, e.g. 2000 = one cycle every 2 seconds.
Duration of a complete pulse or flashing cycle of the main phase in milliseconds.
Duration of a complete pulse or flashing cycle of the switch-off phase in milliseconds.
translations.Blockgröße des Segmentleuchtens in der S: Block size of the segment lighting in the start phase, in LEDs.
translations.Blockgröße des Segmentleuchtens in der H: Block size of segment lighting in the main phase, in LEDs.
translations.Blockgröße des Segmentleuchtens in der A: Block size of the segment lighting in the switch-off phase, in LEDs.
translations.Anzahl LEDs außerhalb des Segments, über: Number of LEDs outside the segment that are linearly faded out. 0 = hard edge.
translations.Laufende Effekte ziehen in der Hauptphas: Running effects leave a softly sloping tail behind them in the main phase.
translations.Schweiflänge der Startphase in Prozent:: Tail length of the starting phase in percent: Total length of light head plus softly sloping tail.
Tail length of the main phase in percent.
translations.Schweiflänge der Ausschaltphase in Proze: Tail length of the switch-off phase in percent.
translations.Ping-Pong-Modus für Wellen: Am Strangend: Ping-Pong mode for waves: The wave reverses at the end of the strand instead of restarting at the beginning.
translations.Animation beim Beenden des Ablaufs, nach: Animation used when the sequence ends after the main phase or an off command. Immediate off switches off without animation.
translations.Dauer der Aus-Animation in Millisekunden: Duration of the off animation in milliseconds. 0 = immediately; with ramp the fading time.
translations.Laufende Effekte ziehen in der Ausschalt: Running effects leave a softly sloping tail behind them in the switch-off phase.
translations.Weiches Überblenden an den Phasenwechsel: Soft fade at the start to ON and ON to OFF phase changes, in milliseconds. 0 = hard change.
Red component of the scene color, 0 to 255.
Green component of the scene color, 0 to 255.
Blue component of the scene color, 0 to 255.
translations.Weißanteil der Szenenfarbe, 0 bis 255. W: White component of the scene color, 0 to 255. Only works with RGBW LEDs; with RGB it is mixed into the color channels.
Base brightness of the sequence, 0 to 255. It is also limited by central brightness and the output's maximum brightness.
